setup.scope: This market covers disposable medical gloves — single-use examination, surgical, and procedure gloves made from natural rubber latex, nitrile, vinyl/PVC, or other elastomers — that are sold for use in healthcare settings (hospitals, clinics, diagnostic labs, dental practices, long-term care, home healthcare, and emergency/EMS) and in medical-adjacent regulated settings where gloves are worn for infection control. It excludes non-medical disposable gloves (food handling, janitorial, industrial, beauty, and consumer household gloves), reusable/durable medical gloves, and glove accessories such as liners or dispensers, which are separately valued markets. Gloves used in food processing or industrial applications are out of scope even when physically identical to medical SKUs, because they are not valued as medical commodities; however, healthcare end-use demand signals (e.g., procedure volumes, hospital admissions, surgery counts, and infection-control glove utilization rates) are legitimate intermediate evidence for deriving how many medical gloves are required, and their use as an input does not place any healthcare usage outside scope.

setup.scope: This market covers disposable (single-use) medical gloves — examination and surgical gloves made from nitrile, latex, vinyl, neoprene, and polyethylene — that are consumed by healthcare providers, diagnostic laboratories, and other clinical care settings and are discarded after a single patient or task use. Excluded are reusable/professional gloves, non-medical or industrial-use gloves (food handling, janitorial, automotive, cleanroom), and glove accessories such as liners or undergloves, which are separately valued markets. Also excluded are the upstream raw materials (natural rubber latex, nitrile butadiene rubber, vinyl chloride) and manufacturing equipment, which are inputs rather than part of this market's own commodity. Non-clinical end-use demand (e.g., food service or industrial glove consumption) is not valued here, though it may be used only as an intermediate signal to cross-check total glove production volumes.
